frozen_candidate.reason: v16 was bit exact and crossed both speed medians, but failed only its unpaired sample-range ceiling. This confirmation changes measurement design, not candidate code.

hypothesis: Within-pair AB/BA ratios will cancel host-frequency and thermal drift enough to determine whether CQ3_0x16 really provides at least 1.08x over CQ3_0x8 and 1.40x over ordinary CQ3 at the exact Qwen3.8-27B two-matrix MLP shape.

measurement.schedule: For each index, run one adjacent comparison pair. Even indices use AB and odd indices BA. Alternate which comparison family runs first every two indices, yielding balanced AB/BA order without changing the kernel.
primary_statistics: median of the 21 within-pair CQ3_0x8_time/CQ3_0x16_time ratios
median of the 21 within-pair ordinary_CQ3_0_time/CQ3_0x16_time ratios
median absolute deviation of each ratio vector divided by its median
measurement.host_idle_precondition: No user compute service or process other than the benchmark may consume at least 1 percent CPU at launch.
measurement.smt_policy: SMT remains enabled, but the benchmark is pinned to logical CPU 0 and its sibling must be idle.

gate_2_successor_kernel.next_target: A separately preregistered CQ3 multi-column kernel for batch widths 2, 4, 6, and 8 that reuses the storage-neutral x16 weights across activation columns.

gate_3_model_and_quality.reason: The frozen candidate is bit-identical to x8 and this experiment changes only the timing harness. Complete-model quality remains mandatory for any separately admitted representation.

stop_rules: Stop before timing if provenance, storage, bit-exactness, finiteness, or numerical error checks fail.
Classify the run as infrastructure invalid rather than failed if CPU pinning, host-idle, frequency telemetry, binary execution, or receipt capture fails.
Reject the frozen x16 candidate if either median ratio misses its threshold or either ratio MAD fraction exceeds 0.03.
Do not change candidate kernel code, pair count, order, thresholds, cache eviction size, or statistics after observing timing output.
Do not run model or capability evaluation in this harness-only confirmation, and do not infer a score for an unrun gate.
claim_boundary: A pass would confirm a stable storage-neutral CQ3_X16 single-column primitive and admit a separate multi-column kernel experiment. It would not establish end-to-end model throughput, target-floor performance, quality, energy, novelty, 100 accepted tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
